name: classpad-monorepo
description: ClassPad system with React frontend and Express backend

scripts.dev: concurrently -n WEB,BACK -c auto "npm --prefix web run dev" "npm --prefix backend run dev"
scripts.dev:ngrok: concurrently -n WEB,BACK,NGROK -c auto "npm --prefix web run dev" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npx wait-on https-get://localhost:5173 --timeout 30000 && ngrok http https://localhost:5173"
scripts.dev:open: concurrently -n WEB,BACK -c auto "npm --prefix web run dev" "npm --prefix backend run dev" && start http://localhost:5173
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix web install && npm --prefix backend install
scripts.install:e2e: npm --prefix tests-e2e install && npx --prefix tests-e2e playwright install chromium
